summary: Genius Sports Limited filed a routine Form 6-K on November 5, 2026, furnishing its interim report and third-quarter 2026 results press release for the period ended September 30, 2026. No transactional event is disclosed: the filing is an ordinary earnings release covering balance-sheet items such as $206.5 million of cash and cash equivalents against $280.6 million at year-end 2025, alongside a rise in intangibles and goodwill consistent with prior acquisitions. No price, stake, premium, board recommendation or advisor is stated, so no special-situation or deal-arbitrage angle applies.
